working_tree: Evaluated product-source revision 0b1ebfcae75c7fe665e08b25996cf8ae3c4d709d is published on main. Hosted ci / required passed on this exact SHA. A fresh independent source review of published revision 11e43e1477c366ca570a1c4cbd2f75f9e668f429 found no source findings. The active GitHub Actions ruleset was exercised through a required-check PR and successful main runs. The protected attestation environment is configured with the repository owner as its sole reviewer; owner self-review is allowed because this is a personal project, and administrator bypass is disabled.

M12-T01.details: python scripts/check.py passed 151 tests across nine milestone modules. The new M5 regression confirms that canonical fingerprints are identical for LF and CRLF text. Context audit passed for 44 canonical pages and 44 manifest rows; projection is FRESH; git diff --check passed.

M12-T02.details: After correcting YAML front matter provenance, regenerated manifest.jsonl; audit passes for 44 canonical pages and rows, with projection FRESH.

M12-T03.details: 22 M3 tests passed, including the dirty consumed-submodule state-change regression using a verified mode-160000 gitlink.

M12-T04.details: 16 tests passed; strict OpenSpec validation passed for the M12 qualification change and the release-provenance companion change.

M12-T05.details: 14 local governance tests passed and local CI obligations were resolved for commit 978c361def2d2805951fd044aa82dedc73160bc4. This is not a hosted ci / required verdict.

M12-T06.details: Windows local-subprocess doctor passed for four stable capabilities. Codex Desktop/CLI is not qualified by this evidence.

M12-T08.details: 29 focused M10 migration/release tests passed, including exact-byte verification/dispatch mutation regressions; mocked calls made no network requests.

M12-T09.details: 29 offline tests cover live API mismatches and jobs total_count, candidate/v1/blocked records, artifact and recomputed-digest tampering, record-path mutation during verify and dispatch, artifact metadata type/format validation, Markdown-safe approval summaries, attestation scope, exact JSON dispatch and size limits, and workflow controls. Mocked calls make no network requests; no hosted workflow or attestation was run.

M12-T10.details: The fresh-context independent review supplied on 2026-09-27 covered published revision 11e43e1477c366ca570a1c4cbd2f75f9e668f429 and reported source PASS with no findings. It confirmed the LF/CRLF fingerprint fix, evidence revision lineage, exact-byte release-provenance behavior, OpenSpec scope, and audited pins. The reviewer did not independently query GitHub CI or live enforcement settings. Earlier FAIL results remain preserved.

M12-T11.details: All eight imported/planned proposals retain a disposition and reopening trigger. No deferred feature mechanisms were added; the targeted release-provenance correction addresses the independent-review finding. The comparison remains qualitative, not a byte-size metric.

limitations: Claude Code qualification remains out of scope per user direction.
Focused release tests use mocked GitHub API and attestation command responses; they make no network requests and do not prove hosted acceptance or repository enforcement.

The original and follow-up independent review results remain FAIL historically. A fresh-context source review of published revision 11e43e1477c366ca570a1c4cbd2f75f9e668f429 passed with no source findings; it did not establish hosted behavior or live enforcement.
A prior working-tree review was BLOCKED on two P3 documentation/provenance findings; both were corrected, and a later review found no remaining finding in those areas.
The independent reviews are read-only source reviews; none establishes hosted behavior or repository enforcement unless separately observed.

A fresh-context independent review found a P3 M12 OpenSpec scope/traceability mismatch. The M12 proposal, design, and tasks were updated to bound the companion release-provenance change; the 2026-09-27 review found no remaining source finding in the reviewed areas.

An independent review found a P2 risk from unvalidated artifact metadata rendered in the protected approval summary. Strict metadata validation and Markdown-safe summary rendering were added; the 2026-09-27 review found no remaining source finding in the reviewed areas.

The initial hosted ci / required run on 2c7d59e failed due to a Windows/Linux line-ending mismatch in the canonical Context fingerprint. The fix was pushed as 0b1ebfc and its exact-SHA hosted run passed; the final published revision later passed fresh-context source review.

The release-provenance-attestation environment requires approval by the sole project owner. Owner self-review is allowed, administrator bypass is disabled, and deployments are limited to protected branches; this does not provide separation of duties.
No release candidate was supplied and no attestation workflow was dispatched. M12 qualifies readiness and enforcement configuration; it does not claim that any release was signed or attested.
The accepted-verdict release path remains unrun; M12 includes the missing-verdict fail-closed smoke and mocked artifact/attestation regressions.
next_actions: For a future release, prepare a candidate, review its artifact hashes, dispatch the attestation workflow, approve the manifest as repository owner, and verify the resulting attestation.
